description: Get FRED macroeconomic time series data (e.g., FEDFUNDS, CPIAUCSL, GDP, UNRATE). Requires FRED_API_KEY env var.

as_of.description: Vintage date (YYYY-MM-DD): the series as it stood then, before later revisions; omitted = latest

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

limit.description: Maximum observations per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_fred_series
title: FRED Economic Series
